note: FLUDARABINE (label FLUDARABINE BASE) has no ChEMBL_37 mechanism record. Its clinical prodrug FLUDARABINE PHOSPHATE is a separate ChEMBL parent (a phosphate ester, not a salt), and its mechanisms (ribonucleoside-diphosphate reductase and DNA polymerase inhibition) are those of the shared active metabolite.

Source structure (skeleton CFCUWKMKBJTWLW) matches PubChem mithramycin (CID 163659) and the unnamed ChEMBL record CHEMBL257619. ChEMBL's approved PLICAMYCIN record CHEMBL1237054 has the same formula (C52H76O24) but a different connectivity (XDKMHMINQXATOR), so identity stays with the structure match; the DNA-inhibitor mechanism is taken from CHEMBL1237054.
